      "code_excerpt": "// PRIMARY: src/Nethermind/Nethermind.Core/ExecutionRequest/ExecutionRequestExtensions.cs:ExecutionRequestExtensions/CalculateHashFromFlatEncodedRequests (lines 33-50)\n// Nethermind (EL) computes and stores RequestsHash in block header after processing all execution requests.\n// CL node receives ExecutionPayload including requests_hash field in engine API.\n// CL independently computes hash from deposit_requests in payload body and compares.\npublic static Hash256 CalculateHashFromFlatEncodedRequests(byte[][]? flatEncodedRequests)\n{\n    using ArrayPoolList<byte> concatenatedHashes = new(Hash256.Size * MaxRequestsCount);\n    foreach (byte[] requests in flatEncodedRequests)\n    {\n        if (requests.Length <= 1) continue;\n        concatenatedHashes.AddRange(SHA256.HashData(requests));\n    }\n    return new Hash256(SHA256.HashData(concatenatedHashes.UnsafeGetInternalArray().AsSpan(0, concatenatedHashes.Count)));\n}"
